title: Wheelset Spoke and Nipple Specifications
seoTitle: Wheelset Spoke Models, Lengths, and Nipple Specifications
seoDescription: Find rim depth, spoke count and crossing pattern, spoke models and head types, and nipple models and lengths for current and legacy DT Swiss, ENVE, Shimano, and Zipp wheelsets. Shimano repair kits match the corresponding diameter specification of the custom SAPIM spokes.
intro: Find replacement spoke and nipple specifications for current and legacy DT Swiss, ENVE, and Zipp wheelsets, plus the matching SAPIM specifications used for Shimano wheelset repairs.
shimanoNoteBody: The Shimano wheelsets listed here use SAPIM spokes custom specified for each wheelset. Repair kits provide the matching SAPIM replacement model for the recorded diameter, head type, and length; nipple specifications are matched to the wheelset.
